2. This revision has been filed to set aside or modify the order dated 12.10.2018 passed by Ajc-Iii,
Ranchi in connection with St Case No. 234/2018 arising out of Lalpur P.S. Case No. 300 of 2017
corresponding to G.R. No. 5176 of 2017 registered for the alleged offence under Sections
376/506/509/379/34/385 of the Indian Penal Code who has dismissed the application of the
petitioner filed under section 227 of the Cr. P.C. 1973 to discharge the petitioner in St Case No. 234
of 2018 and the case is said to be pending in the court of Ajc-Iii, Ranchi.
3.  Vide order dated 06.08.2019 status of the case was called for and has been communicated to this Court vide letter dated 26.08.2019.

Upon perusal of the status report, it appears that two witnesses were examined and six were remaining to be examined from the side of the prosecution as on 26.08.2019 and the next date was 03.09.2019.
4. It appears that the trial has progressed.
5. Since the petitioner is not appearing, this petition is dismissed for non-prosecution.
6. Let this order be immediately communicated to the court concerned through FAX/E-mail.
